decision.reasoning_trace: After filtering out non-backpack products like tent stakes and camping equipment, I focused on five versatile options. The ZOMAKE Ultra Lightweight Hiking Backpack (prod_backpacks_173) was selected as the final choice due to its exceptional value, high rating, and massive number of verified positive reviews (nearly 15,000). While the tactical pack (prod_backpacks_064) had a high rating, it had very few reviews, and the sling bag (prod_backpacks_102) was more specialized for light travel. The ZOMAKE represents the most reliable general-purpose purchase in the set.
